item.title: [DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Fri 19:17): Konstituierende Sitzung | Hörsaal-Sanierung | Bevölkerungsschutz
item.description:
Originally published Fri 30 Oct 2026 19:17 IST.
In Berlin hat sich das neu gewählte Abgeordnetenhaus zu seiner ersten Sitzung getroffen. Die Linken-Politikerin Hendrikje Klein wurde zur Parlamentspräsidentin gewählt. Das aber trat plötzlich in den Hintergrund - wegen eines Berichts des "Spiegel", wonach sich die Bürgermeisterkandidatin Elif Eralp (Linke) vor Terrorsymphatisanten fürchtet. Weitere Themen: Sanierung des von pro-palästinensischen Aktivisten zerstörten HU-Hörsaals deutlich teurer. DRK-Bevölkerungsschutzzentrum in Luckenwalde eröffnet. Und: Ausbau der Bahnstrecke zwischen Angermünde und Stettin verzögert sich weiter.   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Fri 07:57): Venezuelan opposition leader criticises US oil deal
item.description:
Originally published Fri 30 Oct 2026 07:57 IST.

The Venezuelan opposition leader, Maria Corina Machado, has questioned a massive oil deal agreed between Caracas and Washington earlier this year. The accord will see Venezuela hand over twenty per cent of its oil reserves to the US. Speaking at a news conference after her return from exile over the weekend, Ms Machado insisted elections would be held next year, as part of the democratic transition she said was backed by the US. Also: Spanish families desperately search local hospitals in the hope of finding relatives who were hurt in the Toledo train disaster on Wednesday. America's First Lady, Melania Trump, says the ceasefire in the Ukrainian city of Olezhky has been expanded within the Kherson region. The British actor, Patrick Stewart, who gained fame as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek, has died at the age of 86. The Republican governor of Alaska has ordered an investigation into an alleged scheme which led to two men named Dan Sullivan standing in the state's US Senate race. Mike Dunleavy said he was responding to a New York Times story alleging that Democratic party operatives recruited a spoiler candidate. At least 300,000 people could be at risk of future natural disasters in the Himalayas, and we hear from Iranians planning to celebrate Halloween despite the risk of arrest.
